title: Clarín Poll: Flávio Bolsonaro Leads Lula 52–48 in Runoff Survey
detail: A new Clarín poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula 52% to 48% in the first survey ahead of Brazil's presidential runoff (second round). The margin puts Bolsonaro in a slight lead as both camps intensify campaign efforts.

title: Datafolha Poll: Bolsonaro at 49%, Lula at 45% Before Presidential Runoff
detail: Datafolha's latest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro at 49% versus Lula at 45% ahead of Brazil's presidential runoff election. The survey indicates a competitive race with Bolsonaro holding a narrow lead going into the second round.

title: Bolsonaro and Lula Camps Mobilize Supporters on Social Media Ahead of Runoff
detail: Both the Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula campaigns are ramping up social media outreach to attract undecided voters ahead of the presidential runoff. Digital mobilization is playing a central role in both campaigns' strategies for the second round.
